color.accent: theme-derived; never hardcode — derive from the dominant gradient stop
color.chrome: pale blue-grey foundation; a faint blue-to-green fresh tint over a muted neutral base
forbidden: gratuitous gradients in the main content region

typography.headingVoice: 10px, weight 800, uppercase, tracking 0.07em, TEXT colour (not muted)

rules: typography and icon-box geometry are IDENTICAL across densities
the empty slot is still laid out; an appearing dot never shifts a title
the title track is the whole row; trailing actions are display:none at rest
no background behind revealed verbs — the title reflow is the point
folders above loose rows at every level; the disclosure control is always visible

sidebarPartition.footer: pinned status line behind a separator

motion.blinkShape: full off / full on square wave, one shared clock, join by marker
motion.curves: Material-3-style: emphasized decelerate on enter, emphasized accelerate on exit, standard for small shifts
motion.law: decoration must never move text; colour only

loading: stage-curtain: final frame, or a still ghost, or a flat veil — nothing else; latency over flicker

feedback.toastAnchor: viewport-owned: top-centre over terminals, bottom corner over documents; identical style keys in every arm
feedback.destructive: undo by toast, never a confirmation modal; bulk actions name their count

emd.law: analytical components carry an evidence block; a missing sample is null (a gap), never zero

consultationLadder: your layer → the layer below → grow the LOWER layer (never hand-roll) → argue from pixel screenshots
